trigger.note: All256 poles in each128-family suite; correlated poles are not independent samples. Absolute gold likelihood decreases in many cases while foil decreases further.

hypothesis: Relative outcome ranking has no absolute-gold likelihood floor. Add a positive likelihood term on the same TRAIN correct-outcome rows to test whether discrimination gains can coexist with useful continuation probabilities and broad generation quality.
causal_limit: Cached likelihood arithmetic and repeated nonblind dev support this mechanism hypothesis, not a unique causal proof. Shared generator/familiar forms and structural drift remain limits.
new_action: One single added gold-body conditional nonEOS CE term; comparison weights all fixed at1, no coefficient/temperature/margin sweep.

policy.masked_targets: labels>=8; ignore EOS/BOS/role/padding target positions. Remove EOS3 from student conditional vocabulary; preserve parent non-EOS mass weight and all remaining vocabulary IDs.
policy.reference_teacher: immutable actual historical10.5B parent, no optimizer/gradients
policy.replay_policy: separate fork of actual historical parent Web cursor; train only, overlaps first75M primary Web, never dev/test
policy.objective_component: Full parent-to-student KL minus Bernoulli EOS-mass KL; exact weighted conditional non-EOS component only.

policy.row_order: For each family: branch0-candidate0,branch0-candidate1,branch1-candidate0,branch1-candidate1; gold candidate equals branch.
policy.scores: Mean token log probability of complete candidate body, excluding EOS3 from vocabulary normalization; prefix and padding labels ignored.
policy.objective: Mean softplus(foil_score-gold_score) over both context poles of all selected families.
policy.supervision: Relational choice labels and positive/foil scored positions are separate from ordinary CE teachers and parent-KL soft target positions.
policy.input_source: Only already accepted1024 TRAIN families/2048 positive records; other opposite-state outcome is the foil. No dev/probe/test labels.
policy.sampler: Independent local seed42 permutation over all train families, cyclic epochs with seed+epoch; no filtering or global RNG consumption.

positive_anchor.source: Correct candidate rows already present in each frozen TRAIN family batch; no new outcomes/labels/prefixes.
positive_anchor.loss: Conditional nonEOS gold-body CE, sum over all correct body positions divided by their actual count; prefix/padding ignored.
positive_anchor.implementation: Reuse existing eager BF16 math paired-batch logits; combine ranking and positive anchor before backward, then one clip/Adam/scheduler update after mainCE and WebKL.
positive_anchor.supervision_disclosure: Input order/shape and total physical exposure equal completed ranking control, but adds gold-body hard supervision. Integer teachers, relational labels and frozen-parent probability mass remain separate.

budget_gate: Owned actual CUDA4vs2+2 including positive-anchor losses/counts and32 combined timings. Preserve failed/refused costs. Forecast3068updates plus same150second nontraining reserve,30%margin and50second slack plus all new probe costs must fit900 before scientific freeze.
mandatory_quality_gate: Stronger original stagedCE: coherence>=31 and gain>=8/80 with pairedCI lower>0, EOS>=76/repetition<=2/common-byte BPB<=1.1336128657420816*1.01; absolute grammar>=56/coherence>=27/appropriate>=27/EOS>=37/repetition<=18/noempty-role-Unicode; historical-Web BPB<=.9812859519097707 plus existing EOS/repetition/punctuation guards. Never adopt from probe accuracy alone or ease control.
evaluation: Same256 full common bytes/Japanese192-331-1119/all80 greedy and individually read raw-bound notes/bridge128/retention128; report absolute gold and foil NLL separately, not only margin accuracy.
completion_condition: One terminal100M comparison with full accounting/quality review; no automatic extension/favorable checkpoint search/settings sweep. Pilot quality success alone does not complete Base.
after_qualified_pilot: Independent learned seed/full dev/protected test/adoption; notify user and stop after actually qualified Base.
next_action: Implement owned positive-anchor loss/trainer/accountant/runner; CPU masks/directEOS gradient/full-state3samplers resume; then actual CUDA fullresume/timing and measured-budget freeze only if valid. No new GPU learning until its own gate passes.
